notes: C1 prints aggregate totals in right-hand cells merged across subgroup rows. Applicant/admit totals cover the overall cohort; enrollment aggregates can cover either a gender or the overall cohort. Each total is reconciled against its named gender/status cells and is never counted as a second subgroup.

C1 part-time enrollment is printed as a dash. Headline enrollment preserves the explicit overall total. Part-time and resulting gender totals are left unfilled where their source answers are missing; a dash is not converted to zero.
expected.review_method: Independent reading of original C1 gender/status/residency cells and reconciliation with printed totals where provided. Additional source-extracted metrics are not all manually verified.
